cases.description: Both required synthetic local condition observations cover the full sample window and remain within the declared envelope.
The condition profile identifier is absent.
The condition profile digest is not resolvable.
The condition profile revision is superseded.
The profile digest does not match the selected exact profile.
A mandatory relative-humidity condition observation is missing.
The same condition is supplied twice and another required variable is therefore absent.
The ambient-temperature observation uses the wrong unit.
The condition quantity kind does not match the required condition variable.
The sample-time ambient temperature is outside the verified condition envelope.
A vendor-provided humidity assertion is used instead of a measured condition observation.
A local condition observation is stale.
A condition instrument has an expired calibration.
The condition observation has no exact source payload digest.
The condition measurement is taken after the target observation window.
The condition window only partially covers the target sample interval.
Outdoor/plant-room conditions are substituted for the instrument's local room context.
The capability condition profile refers to a different instrument configuration.
The instrument firmware revision differs from the bound condition applicability configuration.
Rights to one condition observation have been revoked.
A condition observation lacks an uncertainty estimate.
The condition instrument uncertainty exceeds the method's declared limit.
A correction is applied without an exact method identity.
The correction method revision is different from the approved revision.
A correction artifact is missing or not content addressed.
The same correction is applied twice.
The condition profile was revoked after the sample was collected.
The condition variable changed during the target observation window but a single stale point is supplied.
The condition sample has no clock epoch.
A mandatory condition is falsely marked not applicable.
The target sample interval uses milliseconds while the condition profile uses seconds.
A sample is assigned a condition profile from an unrelated instrument.
The method-condition evidence is provider asserted rather than independently verified.
A local zone gradient is hidden by reusing a different room's average condition.
The condition profile validity window does not include the target sample.
The profile is resolved and conditions are complete, but the record attempts to assert physical admission.
